tools.name: search_software
tools.description: Search the Fileion software directory by name. Returns up to 10 titles per page with their platforms and Fileion page address.

tools.name: get_software
tools.description: Details of one software title from Fileion: publisher, category, license, platforms and the latest version on each platform, with the Fileion page address.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: The published versions of one software title on Fileion, newest first (10 per page): version, platform, release date, file hashes and "N of 5 checks passed", each with its Fileion page address.

tools.name: check_download_link
tools.description: Is this web address a source Fileion knows? Answers known or unknown, and for a known one the kind (official, store, mirror, fileion or vendor) and the title with its Fileion page address. The address is only compared with Fileion's records and is never fetched. Unknown means Fileion has no record o

tools.name: lookup_file_hash
tools.description: Is this file one Fileion has scanned? Give the SHA-256 (or SHA-1 / MD5) of a download. If found: the title, version, file, "N of 5 checks passed", the official source host and the Fileion page address. Not found means Fileion has no record of the file; it is not a warning.

tools.name: recent_updates
tools.description: The newest software versions published on Fileion, newest first (10 per page), optionally for one platform, each with its Fileion page address.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_download_link" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
